name: p08_auth_wire_golden
description: Contract E.7a / P08 acceptance 6: the P08 auth surface exactly as the live wire carried it. Captured (not hand-written) by the #[ignore] helper p08_auth_wire_capture in murage_conformance_acp.rs, run with --ignored --nocapture on hetzner-dsm lane p08 against the fuigo-pager binary built from strike/p08 a58e47edde922b32176ca09be68f4985a7988634 (capture-tip4.log), with Murage's argv and the two-model MockInferenceServer catalog. authMethods* and authenticateApiKeyCapability are initialize-response fields; authenticateReply and noCredentialError are the agent's replies; authenticateRequest is the exact params object the client wrote, with the key replaced by a placeholder before comparison. Compared as serde_json::Value; any added, removed or renamed key is a contract change.

data.message: fuigo.api_key has no API key. Send one in this request as `_meta["fuigo/apiKey"] = {"key": "<api key>"}` (add `"persist": true` to also save it to auth.json), or start the agent with FUIGO_API_KEY in its environment.
